documents.title: Guidelines and FAQs for Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence Tools at the University of Delaware
documents.stance_why: The guidelines welcome AI ('embraces the responsible use', 'encourages the responsible use of generative AI for teaching and learning') but say the student-use decision 'rests with the instructor', so the document sets no stance for coursework and delegates. Its binding rules concern vetted tools and data.
documents.summary: The guidelines FAQ for the Directive explains generative AI, risks and data rules. It welcomes responsible use, restricts use to vetted tools and limits sensitive data, and leaves course-level decisions to instructors.
